firstPlayerRule: The player who has paid the biggest electricity bill most recently takes the first space on the Turn Order board.
clarifications: During setup, the other players place their Turn Order tokens clockwise in ascending-numbered spaces.
When the game begins, the player whose token is closest to the bill icon acts first, with play continuing clockwise.
